summary: First-iteration backend test run for LectureMind AI. 37 pytest tests written and executed; 36 passed (97.3%). Covered health, auth (signup/login/me, role enforcement, EmailStr+password validation, duplicate=409), lecture upload RBAC, listing, RBAC on detail, background AI error path (GEMINI_API_KEY missing -> status=error), publish error path (400 not-ready, 403 student, 404 non-owner), happy-path publish on seeded ready lecture, /published listing, audio streaming with role checks, quiz scoring math (perfect/partial/mismatch), and delete. One real bug uncovered in MIME validation.

critical.issue: normalize_mime() in services/lecture_service.py falls back to 'audio/mpeg' for ANY unknown file extension (line 45: `return mapping.get(ext, 'audio/mpeg')`). Uploading a .txt file with content-type text/plain is accepted with HTTP 202 instead of being rejected with 400 'Unsupported audio type'. This is a validation/security weakness — arbitrary non-audio files (PDF/EXE/image/HTML) get stored under lectures/<id>/ as if they were MP3s. Fix: change the default to None and reject in upload_lecture when normalize_mime returns None/falsy or not in ALLOWED_AUDIO_MIME.

minor.issue: Endpoint requires authentication (returns 401 without token). The spec says 'any role' which is fine, but consider whether truly public listing is intended. Current behavior: works for both teacher and student; rejects anonymous users. Behaviour is consistent with code (Depends(get_current_user)); flagging for product-decision review only.
FastAPI default error envelope uses {'detail': '...'} — no machine-readable error code/field. Frontend has to string-match on detail. Consider standardising an error shape.

action_items: Fix normalize_mime() default fallback in /app/backend/services/lecture_service.py — do not coerce unknown extensions into 'audio/mpeg'. Return None (or original mime) and let upload_lecture reject with 400.
(Optional) Decide whether GET /api/lectures/published should be public (no auth) — currently it requires a Bearer token.
critical_code_review_comments: services/lecture_service.py normalize_mime defaults unknown extensions to audio/mpeg, allowing arbitrary file uploads to bypass the audio MIME check (real bug, see test_upload_unsupported_mime).

routes/lectures.py: upload_lecture does not verify file.size when the client omits Content-Length (UploadFile.size can be None). A streaming attacker could exceed the 200MB cap. Consider tracking bytes during shutil.copyfileobj or using a chunked size guard.
services/ai_service.py uses synchronous google-genai SDK calls (self._client.models.generate_content) inside `async def` — blocks the event loop. Wrap with asyncio.to_thread or use the async client.
routes/lectures.py delete_lecture returns None with status 204 but storage cleanup is best-effort silent (bare except). At minimum log the exception.
core/security.py / JWT: no expiry assertion in tests; recommend confirming JWT exp is set on create_access_token.
routes/lectures.py get_lecture: students see 403 for unpublished but teachers who are NOT owners also see 403 — consistent, but consider 404 to avoid existence leak.
repositories/lecture_repository.py duplicates created_at/updated_at deserialization logic in list_by_teacher and list_published — DRY violation, extract helper.
services/lecture_service.py process_lecture_background lacks any retry/backoff for transient AI failures.

seed_data_creation: TestQuizScoring class directly seeds StudyMaterials + status='ready' into Mongo (via LectureRepository) for one lecture to validate quiz scoring without the AI provider. All TEST_ prefixed lectures are deleted in fixture teardown. The seeded lecture and 'TEST_ Lecture Intro' are cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_lecturemind_api.py. Run with: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_lecturemind_api.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. The suite is self-contained: it reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (fallback) and signs up the teacher/student credentials if missing. The only failure is the MIME validation bug — once main agent fixes normalize_mime, all 37 should pass. GEMINI_API_KEY is intentionally empty so the background task lands lectures in status=error; the seeded-materials test path validates publish+quiz happy path.
rca of the issue: test_upload_unsupported_mime sends a .txt file with content-type text/plain. Expected: 400 'Unsupported audio type'. Actual: 202 Accepted with audio_mime='audio/mpeg'. Root cause: services/lecture_service.py::normalize_mime returns mapping.get(ext, 'audio/mpeg') — the default 'audio/mpeg' for unknown extensions means the subsequent `if mime not in ALLOWED_AUDIO_MIME` check (line 50 of routes/lectures.py) always passes. Mitigation: change default to None, then in upload_lecture reject if mime is None OR not in ALLOWED_AUDIO_MIME. Repro: `curl -F file=@anything.txt -F title=t -H 'Authorization: Bearer <teacher>' /api/lectures` -> 202.
